_about: CEFR self-assessment grid, A1 column, as published by Europass (copy in _source/reference/cefr-self-assessment-grid-europass-EN.pdf, © Council of Europe). Each can_do statement is checked against its row; rows are folded into the workbook's can_do tab (cefr_row, source) at the end of Phase 2c.
source: CEFR self-assessment grid (Europass copy, Council of Europe 2004-2020), A1

rows.Listening: I can understand familiar words and very basic phrases concerning myself, my family and immediate concrete surroundings when people speak slowly and clearly.
rows.Reading: I can understand familiar names, words and very simple sentences, for example on notices and posters or in catalogues.
rows.Spoken interaction: I can interact in a simple way provided the other person is prepared to repeat or rephrase things at a slower rate of speech and help me formulate what I'm trying to say. I can ask and answer simple questions in areas of immediate need or on very familiar topics.
rows.Spoken production: I can use simple phrases and sentences to describe where I live and people I know.
rows.Writing: I can write a short, simple postcard, for example sending holiday greetings. I can fill in forms with personal details, for example entering my name, nationality and address on a hotel registration form.
